player_prompt.intro:
Nguwe Mdlali {player_id} ulidlala umdlalo we-Pig Dice.

Imithetho:
- Ngelikhatsi lakho, unaweza kukhetsa '[roll]' noma '[hold]'
- Gunda isikhombisa sase 2-6: Ongeza kwi-total yakho yelikhatsi
- Gunda isikhombisa sase 1: Lahleka itotal yakho yelikhatsi bese uyekela ikhatsi lakho
- Gcina: Ongeza itotal yakho yelikhatsi kwi-skoru yakho bese uyekela ikhatsi lakho
- Owayekela kuwa na {winning_score} amaphoyinti uwinile

Ngelikhatsi lakho, uyobona amaskoru anjalo ne-total yelikhatsi.
Phendula ngokusebentisa '[roll]' ukugunda isikhombisa noma '[hold]' ukugcina amaphoyinti akho.
